# langsmith_mcp_vendors (Data Source)

Lists the MCP vendors available to the workspace. MCP vendors are read-only platform-level registrations (no resource counterpart).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_mcp_vendors" "all" {}

output "mcp_vendor_ids" {
  value = [for v in data.langsmith_mcp_vendors.all.vendors : v.vendor_id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this data source.

### Read-Only

- `vendors` (Attributes List) The list of MCP vendors. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vendors))

<a id="nestedatt--vendors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vendors`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Vendor description.
- `icon` (String) URL of the vendor icon.
- `name` (String) Human-readable vendor name.
- `status` (String) `enabled` or `disabled`.
- `vendor_id` (String) Stable identifier for the vendor (e.g. `arcade`).
